verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as it should (headline → copy → CTA) and the 'Shop Sale' button stands out, but the product can is a tiny sliver jammed into the top-left corner with illegible micro-text above it, the 'WEEKEND ONLY' kicker is an unreadable speck floating over the CTA, and the legal line is gone. B puts the CTA and the 'WEEKEND ONLY' label at the far left, ahead of the headline, so the reading order is backwards; the legal text is crammed into an illegible four-line block at the right edge next to a tiny can, and the whole strip feels cluttered, with the headline squeezed in the middle.
